items.summary: Risk disposition: BLOCKED for SearchWoot public beta, full launch, alert expansion, affiliate use, and advertising. Official Woot documentation establishes API access mechanics only; current public terms do not evidence rights to store, derive, cache, publicly display, alert on, or monetize deal and price-history data. Human counsel is required for upstream rights, jurisdictional privacy treatment, and future affiliate or advertising use. Exact decision: keep SearchWoot private and preview-only; keep rights outreach unsent pending counsel review and owner authorization. Ordinary reversible growth elsewhere remains CONDITIONAL when it preserves consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, affiliate, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Fleet compliance disposition: CONDITIONAL, not certification. The technical baseline records 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown across 59 checked sites, with open banner, consent, GA4, privacy, and terms findings. Analytics and SEO evidence are available for configured properties; incomplete telemetry alone does not block ordinary growth. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked where compliance, security, or launch evidence is missing.

Data-quality and revenue disposition: CONDITIONAL. Registry, operational checkouts, analytics, SEO, AI-usage, and revenue ingestion are green; revenue attribution is yellow because the 2026-09-21 Amazon report contains 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission that cannot be assigned to a site. Do not claim site revenue, margin, ROI, payback, forecasts, or causal lift. Preserve unknowns and require every new affiliate link to use its registered tracking ID.

Maintain complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deployment, DNS change, analytics configuration, monetization, spending, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach a dated readiness packet for each site covering ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement boundary, rollback point, and explicit blocker; escalate incomplete packets to CTO at the existing deadline.
